item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Tinubu created a standing, independent civilian complaints body for police or military abuse, or that he publicly disciplined politically protected abusive actors beyond the post-outcry minors case. I also did not find strong direct evidence on prisons, militias, or party enforcers specifically; the strongest material is protest-policing and post-arrest due-process abuse.","evidence":[{"title":"We Will Transform Nigeria Police Into Modern, Professional Force - President Tinubu","publisher":"State House","date":"April 16, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/we-will-transform-nigeria-police-into-modern-professional-force-president-tinubu/","summary":"Tinubu said his administration had begun reforms to make the police more modern, professional, accountable, and better trained. This is positive evidence for institutional accountability, but it is aspirational rather than proof of functioning complaint handling or independent oversight.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"My Resolve To Enhance Nigeria’s Security Unwavering - President Tinubu","publisher":"State House","date":"April 22, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/my-resolve-to-enhance-nigerias-security-unwavering-president-tinubu/","summary":"Tinubu backed the idea of state policing and framed police decentralization as a way to improve accountability and safeguard civil liberties. This is relevant to due process and civilian oversight, though it remains policy-level rhetoric.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Appoints New Leadership for Police Service Commission and Nigerian Police Trust Fund","publisher":"State House","date":"June 10, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-new-leadership-for-police-service-commission-and-nigerian-police-trust-fund/","summary":"Tinubu appointed new leadership to the Police Service Commission and Police Trust Fund, which supports civilian oversight capacity over policing. The notice does not describe a complaint system or an abuse-investigation mechanism, so this is only partial positive evidence.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged deaths and destruction during the protests and told law enforcement to protect lives and property responsibly. This is a weak civilian-protection signal, but it is not itself an accountability mechanism or an independent investigation.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Tinubu orders probe of security agents involved in arrest, detention of minors","publisher":"TheCable","date":"November 4, 2024","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/tinubu-orders-probe-of-security-agents-involved-in-arrest-detention-of-minors/","summary":"Tinubu directed an investigation into the arrest and arraignment of minors detained over the protests, ordered an administrative committee to review arrest, detention, treatment, and release, and said all involved law-enforcement agents would be investigated with disciplinary action if infractions were found. This is the strongest direct positive evidence for 3B.4.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"UNICEF Welcomes President Tinubu’s Order for Immediate Release of Detained Children","publisher":"UNICEF Nigeria","date":"November 5, 2024","url":"https://www.unicef.org/nigeria/press-releases/unicef-welcomes-president-tinubus-order-immediate-release-detained-children","summary":"UNICEF confirmed Tinubu ordered the release of children and young people detained over the protests. This corroborates remedial action, but it still looks like a reactive fix rather than evidence of a standing due-process system.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"Detained Endbad Governance Suspects Released - Vice President Shettima Hands Over Pardoned Suspects To State Governments","publisher":"Federal Ministry of Information and National Orientation","date":"November 5, 2024","url":"https://fmino.gov.ng/detained-endbad-governance-suspects-released-vice-president-shettima-hands-over-pardoned-suspects-to-state-governments/","summary":"The ministry said the detained suspects were released in line with Tinubu’s directive, and that they were handed back to state governments for rehabilitation and reintegration. This supports the view that the presidency eventually corrected part of the abuse, but only after public backlash.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Protesters Charged with Treason","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"September 6, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/06/nigeria-protesters-charged-treason","summary":"HRW said 124 protesters, including children, were held for 60 days pending investigation and then charged with treason, with conditions that raised due-process concerns. This is strong negative evidence: the state response looked punitive and lacked timely independent review.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Police used excessive force to violently quash #Endbadgovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"November 28, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/","summary":"Amnesty reported lethal police force, mass detentions, torture allegations, and denial of wrongdoing by authorities, and explicitly called for an independent and impartial investigation. This is the clearest negative evidence against a functioning accountability system in 2024.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Police used excessive force to violently quash #Endbadgovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"November 28, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/fr/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/","summary":"The French-language version repeats the same findings and is useful as corroboration: excessive force, killings, detentions, and a demand for independent investigation.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"Nigeria: President Tinubu must release all #EndBadGovernance Protesters","publisher":"Amnesty International Nigeria","date":"November 1, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org.ng/2024/11/01/nigeria-president-tinubu-must-release-all-endbadgovernance-protesters/","summary":"Amnesty said protesters were unlawfully detained and charged with “treasonable felony” and terrorism-related offenses, underscoring the absence of due-process safeguards before the later release order.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.2"]}]}
